evidence.title: An okay laptop with 16GB of RAM is better than a nice laptop with 8GB, and this $520 HP OmniBook proves it

summary: A new HP OmniBook priced at $520 highlights that a mid-range laptop with 16GB of RAM can outperform a higher-end model with only 8GB. This underscores the growing importance of memory capacity for modern computing tasks.
title: HP OmniBook Demonstrates 16GB RAM Outperforms 8GB in Budget Laptops
